title: Nov 18–26, 2026
summary: Thanksgiving week: the deepest cuts are 99¢ eggs at Sendik's, sub-$1/lb frozen turkey and $1.99/lb spiral ham at Pick 'n Save, and $1.59/lb wings at Aldi. Ads run Nov 17/18 through Nov 25–26 (Outpost Co+op Deals to Dec 1).

Aldi: end date not stated; Aldi Finds condensed to highlights.

Outpost: Co+op Deals came from the Bay View store's online list, condensed above to household-relevant items (138 total). Several items show no price (Vital Farms eggs, Organic Valley sliced/shredded cheese, Talenti, Izze, Chomps, Q Mixers, Daiya pizza, Beyond steak tips, Tillen Farms cherries). PDF pages 3–16 weren't read image by image.
Sendik's: wine and spirits condensed; the website says prices start 11/17 while the ad pages say Nov 18.
Trader Joe's: comparison with last week's doc wasn't possible; the flyer doesn't flag new items.
